lancha.faq.a1: Snorkeling is not included in the tour, but can be booked as an extra. Please contact our team for details on prices and availability.
lancha.faq.a2: Boat tours usually last between 3 to 5 hours, depending on the chosen route. Check our packages for more details.
lancha.faq.q3: Do I need to book in advance?
lancha.faq.a3: Yes, we recommend booking in advance to secure your spot, especially during peak season.
lancha.faq.q4: How much does the tour cost?
lancha.faq.a4: Costs vary depending on the chosen package. Check our packages for more details.
lancha.faq.q5: What safety measures are in place?
lancha.faq.a5: Our boats are equipped with life jackets and we follow all maritime safety regulations. The crew is trained to ensure a safe experience for all passengers.
lancha.faq.q6: What should I bring on the tour?
lancha.faq.a6: We recommend bringing sunscreen, a hat, sunglasses, swimwear, a towel, and a camera to capture the special moments.
lancha.faq.q7: Are there food options during the tour?
lancha.faq.a7: Some packages include snacks and drinks. Check the details of your chosen package or contact us for more information.
lancha.faq.q8: Is the tour suitable for children?
lancha.faq.a8: Yes, our tours are suitable for all ages. However, we recommend that children under 5 are accompanied by an adult and wear life jackets at all times.

tide.faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about tides in Maragogi
tide.faq.q1: What are tides and why do they change?
tide.faq.a1: Tides are natural variations in sea level caused mainly by the gravitational influence of the Moon and Sun. This phenomenon is completely predictable and repeats daily, allowing you to choose the best time for your tour!
tide.faq.q2: What's the best time to visit the natural pools?
tide.faq.a2: Low tide is when the water level drops, exposing more of Maragogi's natural pools. However, you don't need to wait for the LOWEST tide! Even at medium tides (0.30m to 0.70m), the pools are absolutely accessible, beautiful, and safe for tours. The lower the tide, the more rocks are exposed, but at any tide you'll have an incredible experience!
tide.faq.q3: What if the tide is high?
tide.faq.a3: Even at high tides (above 0.70m), the tour is still excellent! The water is deeper, allowing you to explore different areas, swim around the rocks, and appreciate the beauty of the rock formations. Each tide offers a unique experience!
tide.faq.q4: How do I use this table to choose the best day?
tide.faq.a4: Check the tide table and pick a day with green (low tide) if you want to explore the exposed rocks, or any other day that fits your schedule. Every day is a great day to visit Maragogi! 🌅
tide.tips.title: Professional Tips to Enhance Your Tour
tide.tips.lunar_desc: During full moon and new moon phases, tides are more extreme - you'll see VERY low tides and even more exposed pools! It's the perfect time to explore every corner. But at any lunar phase, the experience is magnificent!
tide.tips.opportunities_desc: Since the tide changes twice daily (every ~6 hours), you have multiple visit opportunities! If one tide doesn't fit your schedule, wait a few hours for the next. Use this table to plan your tour at the BEST time for YOU.
tide.tips.bookmark_desc: Come back here whenever you want to plan your next adventure in Maragogi. Every day is a different opportunity!
tide.legend.title: How to Read the Table and Understand the Arrows and Colors
tide.legend.low_desc: The time when water level is lowest (best for exploring the rocks!)
tide.legend.height_desc: The water level in meters at that time. Each color represents a category:
tide.legend.green_meaning: VERY low tide. Pools super exposed!
tide.legend.yellow_meaning: Medium tide. Perfect for most tours!
tide.legend.red_meaning: High tide. More water, still beautiful!
tide.legend.purple_meaning: Medium tide. Perfect for most tours!
tide.legend.orange_meaning: High tide. More water, still beautiful!
tide.legend.high_desc: The time when water rises to its highest level. The water is deeper, but rock formations are still visible and the tour is amazing!
tide.legend.summary_desc: Use the table to choose the time that best fits your schedule. There's no "wrong time" to visit Maragogi - every tide offers a unique experience!
tide.legend.h2: How to Read the Table and Understand the Arrows and Colors
tide.cta.h2: Choose the Best Day for Your Adventure!
